title: Reinforced Power
subtitle: Durable solar and fuel-backed generation
summary: Reinforced solar panels and biofuel generators are the first Tech Wave upgrade tier.
body: Reinforced Solar Panels use the same solar behavior as baseline panels, but provide a stronger 30 EP/t profile and a larger buffer. Biofuel Generators use fuel-burner behavior and are designed for compact factories that need reliable bursts while batteries recharge.
